overview.about: LIV Golf New York has been staged at Trump National Golf Club in Bedminster, New Jersey, within the wider New York metropolitan area. A championship parkland layout, it brought the LIV team event to one of the biggest sports markets in the United States.
overview.nextEvent: LIV has announced a reduced schedule of 10 events, and a New York-area stop at Bedminster has not been confirmed for the next season. Any return would again pair the individual race with the team competition over 54 holes.
